interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  roles: Array<"admin" | "editor" | "viewer">;
}

function hasRole(user: User, role: User["roles"][number]): boolean {
  return user.roles.includes(role);
}

const users: User[] = [
  { id: 1, name: "Ada", roles: ["admin"] },
  { id: 2, name: "Alan", roles: ["viewer"] },
];

users.filter((u) => hasRole(u, "admin")).forEach((u) => console.log(u.name));
